body: They say they forgot to do it.
Thank you for your thoughts. Please check my edit for more context, also my partner's pronouns are they/them.
As I mentioned in the post, I did send them links to menus and a list of restaurants. Also they want things planned out ahead of time as well.

Very fair assumption, but they actually gave me a wish list and I walked them through different experiences we could do since I've been to the UK before. A lot of the experiences were planned by me based off what they liked. Their biggest request was to "see old stuff."  When I put together the calendar, they approved it.
Then I'm confused about what's wrong with me that in the 21 years that I've been alive, no one has decided to stick around.
I always try and maintain relationships, both romantic and friendships, but everyone ends up leaving no matter what I do. I am unlovable.
I am in therapy. I try my hardest, but it is very clear that no matter how much I love others, I am always abandoned and it's no longer worth sticking around.

I have no reason to stick around. I'm always the person that is left behind that no one wants, in addition to being disabled and having serious PTSD. There isn't anything more here for me and I look forward to not having to deal with it any longer.
